notes.title: Release Date Set Back
notes.notes:
Due to a bit of an overlook, the Steam release date of Going Nowhere: The Dream will be pushed back. The release date will tentatively be set to [b][u]the 23rd of November but it will likely take longer[/u][/b]. There will be another announcement when the game goes live so please follow the Steam page!

As an apology [b][u]the one week launch discount will increase to 15%[/u][/b], lowering the launch price of the game to [b][u]$6.80[/u][/b].

Going Nowhere: The Dream will still be available on other distributors on the 20th of November as planned. Check http://www.stephanhaldaman.com/goingnowherethedream.html for more information.
